description: Hand-written retrieval questions. Each is phrased WITHOUT the answer's key term, so it tests semantic matching as well as keywords. A hit = at least one of the top-k chunks (from the given quarter's call, if set) contains one of the expected terms. Terms were checked against the transcripts.
